title: NFL players 4 times more likely to die of neurodegenerative disease, new study finds

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL players 4 times more likely to die of neurodegenerative disease, new study finds
sources.description: A new study reviewed health data from 19,824 football players who participated in at least one game between 1960 and 2019. The results were 'immense.'
